verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is itself a personal AI assistant: users chat with it to hand off tasks (docs-1, docs-96, docs-68). The docs cover background sub-agents, swarm fan-out, scheduled automations and standing orders that grant ongoing operating authority (docs-20, docs-56, docs-80, docs-27, docs-29). Hands-on reports corroborate real delegation, such as a user offloading VM, Prometheus and Grafana setup, and another running 9 scheduled agents (comm-8, comm-15). Missing for 10: consistent independent evidence of reliability, since one user reported tasks often not completing as intended, a general complaint without a concrete counter-example.
